frame_encoding.note: The IP-06 runtime owns the single stdin reader, the single serialized stdout writer, and the length prefix. IP-07 materializes fixture bytes but must not read a stream or implement a second length-prefix reader.

limit_precedence.note: A full eligible-tab record is bounded well below 26 bytes, so 10,001 records cannot fit inside the 256 KiB JSON payload cap and the payload cap binds first. The record cap stays a defence-in-depth bound asserted at its own boundary, not a wire-observable rejection.
